findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11 Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events. A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT.

The procedure available in the facility indicates the use of a chemical that is not effective for disinfecting Norovirus, which is a primary concern for this situation. Education was conducted and the company consulted. A bottle of bleach was acquired during this inspection and a hand out given related to the use of bleach to correct. Ensure that all procedures and chemicals in the facility are effective for the health concerns that they are intended to manage.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114.

A rag was observed on the counter during the inspection. The PIC confirmed that it was intended for wiping the counter throughout the day. Education was conducted and the rag moved to the sani bucket to correct. Ensure that the sani rags are stored in a sanitizer of effective concentration at all times.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On the inspector’s arrival, the facility was without a ready for use sanitizer as the jug of concentrate had run dry. Education was conducted and the company contacted. A new jug was received during the inspection to correct. Ensure that there is always an available sanitizer in the facility when it is in operation.
